text:
paul: Kicking off the "Harbor" micro-nurture tied to next week's benchmark webinar. Need final segment CSV, send windows, and two subject directions. Short thread to align.

ivy: Propose timezone-aware sends: APAC 08:30 local, NA 11:00 local, EMEA 16:30 local. For live reminders use -2h and -15m.

nora: Segment draft (CSV headers below):
```
segment_id,filter,notes
harbor_trial_10d,trial_started<=10d,high-intent trials
harbor_active_21d,last_open<=21d,engaged users
harbor_cold_240d,last_engagement>240d,reactivation test
```
Exclude `no_marketing` and any unsubscribed in 30d. Also filter out `privacy_review=true`.

ops: Ops constraints: daily cap 950k. Recommend concurrency 160, batch 120, ramp 12m. Throttle per-provider 5k/min. Failover: if 5xx >2.5% for 5m, route failing recipients to s3://marketing/harbor/fallback.csv and swap provider. Add soft pause: pause region if bounce_rate>2.7% over 20m.

paul: Creative ask: two subject directions 1) "How we halved token cost" (value) 2) "Benchmarks we didn't expect" (curiosity). Keep short mobile variant <=40 chars. Preheaders: "Register + checklist" / "Replay + configs".

ivy: Cadence: invite -> 36h follow-up -> 4-day reminder -> 2h live nudge -> post-webinar recap + playbook. For harbor_trial_10d shorten to invite -> 24h -> 48h -> recap.

nora: RSVP gating: single-question use-case radio. Map answers to inbound tags: `harbor:platform|ops|product`. SDR-bot will create leads with those tags. Also include UTM params: utm_campaign=harbor_launch&utm_medium=email&utm_source=campaign.

sdr-bot: When RSVP received, creating lead: tag=`harbor`, route based on `harbor:` tag. If reply contains "book demo" escalate to `high_intent` queue.

deliverability-bot: Quick tip: for cold cohort use plain-text first send and minimal images. Avoid AMP. Limit image-to-text ratio to improve inboxing.

paul: @ops can you pull final segments from s3://marketing/harbor/segments_final.csv? I'll pin the plan once uploaded. Also want a small staged rollout: 5% warm -> 35% ramp -> rest after 20m if metrics OK.

ops: Confirmed. Will stage: 5% warm (15m monitor) -> 35% ramp (30m) -> remaining 60%. Limits applied and failover path set. We'll export 500-recipient preview files for creative QA to s3://marketing/harbor/previews.csv.

ivy: A/B plan: engaged_21d -> 60/40 value/curiosity. trial_10d -> 70/30 value/social proof. cold_240d -> even split across 3 variants (value/curiosity/short). We'll track opens, CTR, register rate, and 7-day trial activation.

paul: Nice. Debrief scheduled Fri 9am PT. I'll upload the final CSV and drop a pinned note in #marketing. Thanks everyone. :anchors_up:
